notes.title: Fellowship Patch v0.16.00
notes.notes:
Prepare yourselves, adventurers, for the unveiling of patch v0.16.00, introducing a realm shrouded in mystique and peril: The Enchanted Forest. This latest addition to your quest against Goltar offers not only new challenges but also the chance to wander through wonders unseen and foes unbeknownst.

[h2]Step Into The Enchanted Forest[/h2]
Within The Enchanted Forest, every shadow and shimmer holds a secret, and every glade brings a new test of your bravery and skill. This bewitching domain is alive with magic, where the very ground beneath your feet may decide your fate. Will the whispers among the leaves guide you to safety, or will they lead you into the heart of danger? Only the bravest heroes dare to tread this path, seeking to unveil its mysteries while confronting the darkness that lurks within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241495/f00ab1be137b01dcfc3e7d4ba419c8b4f197aa20.gif[/img]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]New Map:[/h3]

Enchanted Forest: A labyrinth of enchantment and danger awaits.
[h3]Enemies:[/h3]
Rebalances in Sand Dunes' Boss:
- Increased movement speed
- Increased melee attack radius
Geyser Attack:
- Increased number of geysers per attack
- Increased geysers duration
Beam Attack:
- Reduced charge time
- Reduced Beam duration

[h3]General:[/h3]
- Minor performance optimization

We're eager for you to experience the allure and challenges of The Enchanted Forest. Venture forth, share your tales of adventure, and let us know how this new realm shapes your journey to thwart Goltar’s malice.

The Fellowship Team

notes.title: Fellowship Update: Patch 0.15.00
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce the release of patch 0.15.00, focusing on enriching gameplay with new content. This update is all about giving players more options to create unique builds and gameplay strategies.

[h2]Introducing Spiral Carnage Combo Skill[/h2]
Experience the Barbarian's latest feat, "Spiral Carnage." Armed with blades from the Lancer & Warrior, the Barbarian executes the Blunt Gyro maneuver, hurling two spiraling blades that inflict damage to enemies in their path and carve a route of devastation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241495/5df43647e547b004f57ecedb3a0cce7ea7351856.gif[/img]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New Perks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Formation Boost: Enhances the effects of formation buffs.
[*] Combo Master: Reduces the energy cost of combo skills.
[*] Fast Hands: Increases the frequency of interval-based synergies.
[/list]
[h3]Skills & Synergies[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Combo Skill: Spiral Carnage.
[*] Archer: 3 new synergies.
[*] Lancer: 3 new synergies.
[*] Priest: 1 new synergy.
[*] Holy Knight: 1 new synergy.
[*] Fire Mage: 2 new synergies.
[*] Barbarian: 2 new synergies.
[*] Adjustments to various existing synergies.
[/list]
[h3]Level Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the number of eel enemies in the Sand Dunes biome.
[/list]
[h3]General Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added visual effect for the daze condition
[*] Heroes stop attacking after being dazed bug fixed
[*] Various minor bug fixes and optimizations
[/list]

We're eager for you to try out these new additions and enhancements. Your feedback is always welcome, as it helps us continue to improve and expand Fellowship. Share your experiences and ideas with us on our Discord and through our community channels.

Happy adventuring,
The Fellowship Team

notes.title: Fellowship Update: Version 0.14.00
notes.notes:
This week, we're thrilled to introduce new content that further enriches the world of Fellowship. Dive into the details of what this update has in store!

[h2]Discover the Sand Dunes![/h2]
Our heroes have stumbled upon a mystifying new region: the Sand Dune. In this surreal landscape, sea creatures have been spotted swimming through desert dunes. What secrets do these sands hold?

[h2]Meet the Storm Mage[/h2]
In their travels, the heroes have encountered a renowned mage with the power to control the weather. Once a free spirit of Elderida, this mage has fallen captive to Goltar's hordes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241495/e49c91d803bc19a56953af81d14182ae14d6a16c.gif[/img]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[b]Settings Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now resize heroes' avatars in the game HUD.
[*] New in-game camera zoom control.
[/list]
[b]New Level:[/b]
[list]
[*] Introducing the Sand Dunes biome.
[*] Encounter unique mobs and bosses in the Sand Dunes.
[/list]
[b]New Hero:[/b]
[list]
[*] Storm Mage joins the adventure.
[/list]
[h3]Rebalancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Party rotation speed has been doubled.
[*] Volcanic Wasteland mobs rebalancing:
[*] Magma Beetle: Increased durability and damage.
[*] Magma Golem: Enhanced durability.
[/list]
[h3]General Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved text size for better readability, especially on SteamDeck.
[*] Fixed inconsistencies in attack indicators following mob deaths.
[*] Various minor bug fixes.
[*] Overall game optimization.
[/list]
We're excited for you to experience these new additions and enhancements. As always, your feedback is invaluable. Share your thoughts and suggestions with us on Discord and our community channels.

The Fellowship Team

notes.title: Fellowship Update: Patch 0.13.00
notes.notes:
This week's update brings two major additions to Fellowship, alongside several performance optimizations and bug fixes.

[h2]Treasure Goblin[/h2]
Adventurers across the Elderida kingdom have reported sightings of a mysterious Treasure Goblin. This elusive creature, appearing in various biomes, has been seen stealing gold coins, crystals, and other goods. However, those skilled enough to land a barrage of attacks on this burglar have found their stolen goods returned tenfold!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241495/bddbd0f0e0eaed3e59e69689b2aa68f16b6f9a80.gif[/img]

[h2]Wave System Rebalancing[/h2]
Based on community feedback, we've revamped the wave system behavior, enemy spawn rates, and overall wave tempo. The waves are now smoother and more frequent. We're eager to hear your thoughts on these changes.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] All stages have been rebalanced.
[*] Introducing the new Treasure Goblin, with a spawn chance in all stages.
[*] Equipment drop rarity has been rebalanced for all stages.
[/list]
[h3]Heroes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Party base movement speed increased by 33%.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Corrected some non-English localized strings in Perk cards.
[*] Fixed alignment issues with some hit VFX.
[*] Objective indicators will no longer cover HUD items.
[*] As always, we thank you for your continued support and feedback, which are invaluable in our quest to make Fellowship an ever-improving adventure. If you have any thoughts or suggestions, don't hesitate to share them with us on our Discord server and through our community channels.
[/list]

Stay adventurous,
The Fellowship Team

notes.title: Fellowship Update: Patch 0.11.00
notes.notes:
We're excited to bring you the latest update for Fellowship, version 0.11.00. This patch includes general game polish, optimizations, bug fixes, and focuses on two major enhancements:

[olist]
[*] [b]New Equipment Sets System[/b]
[*] [b]Steam Achievements[/b]
[/olist]
[h2]Equipment Sets[/h2]
As part of our ongoing effort to enhance the equipment system and diversify gameplay, we're introducing equipment sets. These sets provide unique buffs and open up new build possibilities. You can find set items dropping from normal mobs, bosses, and specific mob types or elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241495/92ef2669a2f03e2b0dace5425a7566fd7bd31d33.gif[/img]

In this patch, we're introducing the following sets as the first in a series:
[list]
[*] [b]Scavenger’s Set[/b]: Bonus for additional loot and resources, drops from Rats, Goblins & Humans.
[*] [b]Elemental Fury Set[/b]: Provides elemental damage and resistance, drops from elemental mobs.
[*] [b]Beastmaster Set[/b]: Boosts criticals and resistance against animal-type enemies, drops from animal-type mobs.
[*] [b]Marksman Set[/b]: Increases attack speed and adds a projectile for ranged heroes, drops from various ranged mobs.
[*] [b]Gladiator Set[/b]: Enhances melee attack range, scale, and crits, drops from melee mobs.
[/list]
Additionally, the equipment drop rate has been significantly increased. We've replaced the equipment box drop with the actual equipment, making it visible during the run. Keep an eye out for rare, mythical, or legendary items, now marked with a new beam of light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241495/bfb89325286e47eba05c98d3256052ffd2217d61.gif[/img]

[h2]Steam Achievements[/h2]
This patch marks our first foray into Steam achievements and in-game quests. Dozens of new achievements are now available for you to conquer and showcase. In upcoming updates, we'll tie in-game quests directly to Steam achievements, offering rewards like items and new features to strengthen your party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241495/a99c35ed7d8184413db20ac4b6df432a54458685.png[/img]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New Things[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated look for item drops, displaying the actual item and its rarity on the map.
[*] New Sets: Marksman, Gladiator, Scavengers, Beastmaster, Elemental Fury.
[*] Added delay before match ends after killing a boss to see and pick up loot. Boss-dropped loot will be auto-claimed if missed.
[/list]

[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced mini bosses' status effect resistance from 50% to 30%.
[*] Changed boss drop table, with a guaranteed change from 1 to 2 equipment drops and a chance for additional drops.
[*] Updated mini boss loot drop, with a chance to drop an additional equipment.
[*] Doubled wearable drop chance from normal mobs.
[/list]
[h3]General Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed game stutter when boss spawns.
[*] Added and corrected some missing localized strings.
[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]

We're grateful for everyone who enjoys Fellowship and shares their experiences and feedback. If you have ideas for a new equipment set, unique Steam achievements, desired features, or just want to [b]share your feedback[/b], join us on our [b]Discord server[/b] and[b] Steam discussion[/b] group.

The Fellowship Team

notes.title: Fellowship Version 0.1.04
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce two major features in update v0.1.04, developed in response to valuable community feedback. Along with these features, we are introducing a changelog detailing other enhancements and fixes.

[h2]New Feature: Aim Assist[/h2]
Understanding that some players found the precision required for aiming by rotating the formation challenging, we've introduced an "Aim Assist" feature. This addition will make precision targeting less frustrating, as party heroes will now automatically aim at enemies within a 90-degree angle of their general aiming direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241495/8f28861c4d63877afd0f3592a288fb096b0b946e.gif[/img]

[h2]New Feature: Reroll[/h2]
Addressing community concerns about choice limitations and hard RNG in card selection, we've made two key changes:
1. The number of offered cards has been increased from 3 to 4.
2. Players can now reroll the offered cards to increase the likelihood of getting desired cards.

Each run starts with 3 free rerolls, and additional reroll items may drop from bosses or be found in breakable objects across the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241495/c4beaa35b3bc7f80b7c63bd5b9fd7185a2c7d100.gif[/img]

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[h3]New Additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added Aim Assist Feature for easier targeting.
[*]Introduced Card Reroll Feature:
[*]Start each match with 3 rerolls.
   - Defeating a mini boss grants a reroll.
   - Chance to find reroll items in breakable objects.
[*]Two new perks introduced:
   - Sprint Duration Upgrade
   - Cooldown Reset Perk
[*]Increased the number of cards offered per level up from 3 to 4.
[/list]

[h3]Enemies:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted attack and animation speeds for most mini bosses.
[*] Fixed sound effects for kamikaze goblins.
[/list]

[h3]General Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved issues in item tooltips.
[*] Implemented general bug fixes.
[*] Updated several strings for the Korean localization.
[/list]

We’re constantly striving to improve Fellowship based on your feedback. Stay tuned for these exciting new features and enhancements!
The Fellowship Team

notes.title: Fellowship Game Update 0.1.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The 0.1.0 update for Fellowship is here, and it brings a bunch of improvements and new features that we hope you'll enjoy. Check out what's new and what's been fixed below.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]

[list]
[*]We've added support for wide monitors.
[*]Controller support has been improved.
[*]There's a new status effect resistance attribute for mini bosses (50%) and bosses (100%).
[*]“Release Lancer” quest is now delayed until first mini-boss encounter.
[*]Booster items have been removed; introducing altars with buffs and other effects instead.
[*]The world map UI has been updated. It now shows more info about the selected region, available quests, and allows for difficulty selection (more difficulties coming soon).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241495/9f5bdd206173b490f3777b5f02a8dc1b4b19e286.gif[/img]

[h2]Hero Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*]7 New synergies have been added.
[*]Archer's Piercing Arrows synergy has been changed from passive to active.
[*]All heroes now have new sound effects.
[/list]

[h2]Enemy Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]We've rebalanced mob spawning across all levels.
[*]Lava fly and lava fly slime are now twice as big.
[*]Elementals have had their speed decreased slightly.
[/list]
 
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]General bug fixes throughout the game.
[*]Fixed an issue with not enough mobs spawning.
[*]Corrected a bug where characters were taking damage when they shouldn't be.
[*]Disabled collision for breakable map objects.
[*]Objective markers are now removed at the end of a match.
[*]We've fixed the anchor for the kill counter and formation UI in the HUD.
[*]No more items or characters spawning inside lava pools.
[*]Added position validation for spawning environment actors.
[*]Lava pools collision layers have been fixed.
[*]Fixed the flame thrower getting stuck.
[*]Resolved controller issues in the settings UI.
[*]Fixed workshop layout problems for non-standard resolutions.
[/list]

We're committed to making Fellowship the best game it can be, and this update is part of that process. Thanks for your support, and we hope you enjoy the new version!

The Fellowship Team

notes.title: Fellowship Patch Update 2023-09-29
notes.notes:
Hello Heroes of Elderida,

In this new update, version 0.0.47, our main focus has been to polish the synergy system and introduce several new synergies between your party members. For those unfamiliar, synergies are passive and active skills triggered by meeting specific conditions between your party members; thus, each selection of which hero to recruit or skill to unlock and upgrade will trigger different synergies to enhance your gameplay.

[h2]Accessing Synergy Screen[/h2]
In this version, you can access the synergy screen in-game by pressing the default [f] key on your keyboard or [select] if using a controller. The screen displays the list of synergies you've discovered or yet to, which are active, and their requirements if previously discovered, helping you decide on which gameplay build you’d like to push to. Additional information will be introduced in the next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241495/15bac11760b1b2b9fff9147ca80dd95f73e332c7.png[/img]

[h2]Settings Screen & Key Bindings[/h2]
We have reshaped the Setting screen a bit, and now you are able to configure and change your key bindings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241495/dae5ab513119d8e9a86b34cb065f5791d8ac2aa4.png[/img]

In the next update, we will focus on polishing and balancing existing content along with minor additions.

[h3]Change Log | Version 0.0.47[/h3]

[b]New Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] New settings screen design.
[*] Ability to change key bindings added.
[*] New synergies UI - Press F while in game to open.
[*] 9 new synergies for heroes (including new skills).
[/list]

[b]Level: Ruins Of Eldrida[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemy density rebalanced - overall increased the amount of monsters during the stage and reduced it in the last phase.
[/list]

[b]General Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebalance for equipment drops.
[*] Hot key indicator added to the synergy counter in the HUD.
[*] Bug fixes in the inventory UI.
[*] Bug fix with the visuals of some attacks.

[/list]

We continue to welcome your feedback as we refine and enhance Fellowship experience. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Fellowship Patch Update 2023-09-22
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes of Elderida,

We're profoundly thankful to everyone who has played and continues to enjoy the demo. Your invaluable feedback has been instrumental in shaping improvements and refining the gaming experience for all. This patch primarily addresses balancing for various heroes, skills, and mobs while resolving bugs within the Inventory & Workshop.

We've also noticed that some game mechanics are underutilized. We believe a direct explanation from our team can help players fully experience the game.

[h3]Features[/h3]
[b]Instructions and HUD[/b]
[list]
[*] Instructions now displayed on the HUD at game start and upon acquiring 3 party members for the first time, aiding player understanding of the game mechanics.
[*] Objective indicators are now more visible, providing clearer guidance to players.
[/list]

[b]Controller Control Scheme[/b]
[list]
[*] Movement: Left Joystick
[*] Aim: Right Joystick
[*] Rotate Party: Left/Right Bumpers
[*] Sprint: Right Trigger
[*] Change Leader: Left Trigger
[*] Expand Formation: Right Joystick Click
[*] Shrink Formation: Left Joystick Click
[*] Change Formation: Y/Triangle
[*] Combo Skills: Directional Keys
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[b]Heroes[/b]
[b]General[/b]
Movement speed perk bonus from speed upgrades reduced:
[list]
[*] Uncommon: 25% → 23%
[*] Rare: 30% → 26%
[*] Legendary: 35% → 30%
[/list]

[b]Barbarian[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced all skills and fixed related issues.
[*] Added a “pulse” effect to the “Smash” skill, causing the attack to repeat multiple times at the same location.
[/list]

[b]Enemies[/b]
[b]Goblin King[/b]
[list]
[*] Skill changed from a damage buff to a summon skill.
[*] Jump Skill: Land duration adjusted from 1 second to 2 seconds.
[*] Melee Attack: Charge duration adjusted from 1 second to 0.8 second.
[/list]

[b]Hob Goblin[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased movement speed for enhanced mobility.
[/list]

[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stats and gems recalibrated for balanced gameplay and enhanced equipment parity.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved filter drop-down list text issue in the inventory when the armor tab is selected.
[*] Fixed the ESC key functionality in the settings menu.
[*] Addressed various bugs in the main menu.
[*] Rectified the absence of gems in the workshop.
[*] Incorporated some missing localizations for improved game understanding.
[/list]

We hope these adjustments and enhancements resonate with your gaming experience, and we look forward to your continued engagement and feedback to refine Fellowship.

Best,
Elraim Studio
